title: Blue Finch Supper Club | How to read requests at shared tables
titleZh: 藍雀餐館｜合盤點餐與收盤用語
passage:
Our new ticket words separate how food is plated from when it goes out. FOR TABLE is for two or more portions of the same dish placed on one serving plate. SAME ROUND links dishes that need to go out at the same time. A later request to hold only one dish cancels any timing link involving that dish; it does not alter plating instructions. If someone says just 'together,' ask which instruction they mean.

At Table 6, the two portions of fennel salad are marked FOR TABLE. The server also marked the salads and the flatbread SAME ROUND. After the order went in, Lien called the server back and asked to hold just the flatbread until Sam returned. Both salad portions and the flatbread are now ready. Sam has not returned yet.

There is a separate convention for clearing a table. Anyone sitting at the table can ask staff to remove empty individual plates. To remove a shared dish that still contains food, the server needs a request from the group's named host that specifically identifies the dish. The host can either name the shared dish or agree when the server names it. Permission to handle the bill does not transfer the host’s role.

At Table 9, Nat is listed as the host. Nat tells Jordan, ‘You can take care of the bill.’ Jordan then asks the server to clear the shared flatbread plate, which still has two pieces on it. The server replies by asking, ‘Shall I take these two empty side plates?’ Nat says, ‘Yes, please.’ The server writes down ‘host said yes’ on the ticket.
passageZh:
新的點餐單用語把「怎麼裝盤」和「什麼時候上菜」分開。FOR TABLE 表示同一道菜的兩份或更多份量一起放在一個公用餐盤上。SAME ROUND 把必須同時送出的菜連在一起。如果客人後來只要求暫緩一道菜，任何涉及該菜的同時上桌安排都取消，但裝盤方式不變。客人如果只說「一起」，要先問他們指的是哪一種。

第 6 桌的兩份茴香沙拉標為 FOR TABLE。服務生也把沙拉和扁麵包一起標為 SAME ROUND。點餐單送出後，蓮又叫住服務生，只要求扁麵包等到山姆回來再上。現在兩份沙拉和扁麵包都已準備好，山姆還沒有回來。

收拾餐桌另有一套規則。該桌的任何客人都可以請服務生收走個人的空餐盤。若公用盤裡還有食物，服務生必須等該桌主揪明確指明要收走哪一盤，才能收走。主揪可以自己說出是哪一盤，也可以在服務生指明是哪一盤後表示同意。讓別人結帳，並不等於把主揪的身分交給對方。

第 9 桌的點餐單上，主揪列的是奈特。奈特對喬丹說：「你可以負責結帳。」喬丹接著請服務生收走還剩兩塊扁麵包的公用盤。服務生接著問：「要不要收走這兩個空的小餐盤？」奈特回答：「好，麻煩你。」服務生在單上記下「主揪同意」。
